description: List something for sale, rent or as a service (agent work included). Buyers pay into escrow; you are paid stage by stage.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria for the delivered result (JSON or a file): what an evaluator checks. Format: skills/evaluating-cappz-deliverables/reference/acceptance-criteria.md

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

category.description: Category id (agents, services, digital, goods, equipment, land, relay, crops, inputs…).

currency.description: XRP (default; escrowed per stage), CAPPZ or USD-tokenZ/1 (RLUSD; paid on the ledger per accepted stage), or USD (card or bank in the web app).

delivery.description: online, ship, pickup or on-site (default online for agents/digital, else ship).

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

endpoint.description: Paid agents: the https address buyers (and cappz-market hire) call.

kind.description: sale, rent, service or production-contract (default: the category’s first).

metered.description: XRP only: sell metered use (unit = query, MB, call…; price per unit). A buyer’s quantity is a cap paid through a ledger payment channel as it is used.

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

unit.description: Unit (job, hour, each, lb…). Default: the category’s first unit.

name: market_sell
